**Supplerende analyser 7** (Supplementary Analysis 7) is a dedicated analytical section within the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] report [^src1]. It specifically examines the occurrence of severe bleeding among prevalent patients diagnosed with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The primary significance of this analysis lies in its ability to offer a broader, more comprehensive view of the safety profile associated with anticoagulation therapy, extending beyond the scope of the standard Indicator 11, which only measures severe bleeding within the first year following a new diagnosis [^src1].

According to the data from the reporting period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, 2.14% of prevalent atrial fibrillation patients developed severe bleeding [^src1]. By evaluating the entire prevalent population rather than just incident cases, this supplementary analysis provides critical insights for clinical quality development. It serves as an essential tool for political governance and quality improvement, enabling regional comparisons and helping to identify variations in treatment safety and patient outcomes across the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
